package student

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
)

type testBuilderRegistry struct{}

func (testBuilderRegistry) GetStarter(string) (domain.StarterBuilder, bool) {
	return testStarterBuilder{}, true
}

type testStarterBuilder struct{}

func (testStarterBuilder) Supports(string) bool { return true }

func (testStarterBuilder) BuildStarter(context.Context, domain.StarterBuildInput) (domain.StarterBuildResult, error) {
	return domain.StarterBuildResult{}, nil
}

func TestBuildMilestonePreviewUsesStoredValidationContract(t *testing.T) {
	milestone := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		MilestoneKindCode: "html_page_shell",
		ValidationContractJSON: json.RawMessage(`{
			"version": 7,
			"kind": "workspace_contract",
			"workspace": {"required_files": ["custom.html"]},
			"stages": [{"id": "custom", "engine": "custom.engine", "rules": {"source": "catalog"}}]
		}`),
	}

	preview, err := (BuildUseCase{Builders: testBuilderRegistry{}}).BuildMilestonePreview(
		context.Background(),
		domain.PracticeTask{LanguageCode: "en"},
		milestone,
		nil,
	)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build milestone preview: %v", err)
	}
	if preview.Contract.Version != 7 || preview.Contract.Stages[0].Engine != "custom.engine" {
		t.Fatalf("expected the stored catalog contract, got %#v", preview.Contract)
	}
	if len(preview.Contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles) != 1 || preview.Contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles[0] != "custom.html" {
		t.Fatalf("expected stored workspace requirements, got %#v", preview.Contract.Workspace.RequiredFiles)
	}
}

func TestBuildMilestonePreviewRejectsInvalidStoredValidationContract(t *testing.T) {
	milestone := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		MilestoneKindCode:      "html_page_shell",
		ValidationContractJSON: json.RawMessage(`{"version":1,"kind":"workspace_contract","stages":[]}`),
	}

	_, err := (BuildUseCase{Builders: testBuilderRegistry{}}).BuildMilestonePreview(
		context.Background(),
		domain.PracticeTask{LanguageCode: "en"},
		milestone,
		nil,
	)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected validation error, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestBuildMilestonePreviewUsesImmutableStoredStarter(t *testing.T) {
	milestone := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		MilestoneKindCode: "unknown_to_local_registry",
		StarterWorkspaceJSON: json.RawMessage(`{
			"files":[{"path":"index.html","content":"<!-- authored starter -->"}],
			"readonly_files":[],
			"editable_files":["index.html"],
			"entrypoints":["index.html"],
			"preview_config":{"entrypoint":"index.html"},
			"meta":{"source":"revision"}
		}`),
		ValidationContractJSON: json.RawMessage(`{
			"version":1,
			"kind":"workspace_contract",
			"stages":[{"id":"html","engine":"html.dom"}]
		}`),
	}

	preview, err := (BuildUseCase{}).BuildMilestonePreview(context.Background(), domain.PracticeTask{}, milestone, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("build stored starter: %v", err)
	}
	if len(preview.Starter.Files) != 1 || preview.Starter.Files[0].Content != "<!-- authored starter -->" {
		t.Fatalf("expected exact revision starter, got %#v", preview.Starter)
	}
}

func TestBuildMilestonePreviewRejectsUnsafeStoredStarterPath(t *testing.T) {
	milestone := domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		StarterWorkspaceJSON: json.RawMessage(`{
			"files":[{"path":"../secret","content":"bad"}],
			"entrypoints":["../secret"]
		}`),
		ValidationContractJSON: json.RawMessage(`{
			"version":1,
			"kind":"workspace_contract",
			"stages":[{"id":"html","engine":"html.dom"}]
		}`),
	}

	_, err := (BuildUseCase{}).BuildMilestonePreview(context.Background(), domain.PracticeTask{}, milestone, nil)
	if !errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation) {
		t.Fatalf("expected unsafe starter rejection, got %v", err)
	}
}

func TestMilestoneRuntimeProfileUsesStoredRevisionValues(t *testing.T) {
	code, compose, err := milestoneRuntimeProfile(domain.PracticeTaskRuntimeMilestone{
		MilestoneKindCode: "html_page_shell",
		RuntimeProfileJSON: json.RawMessage(`{
			"code_structure_type_code":"CUSTOM_WORKSPACE",
			"compose_config":{"services":{"app":{"image":"custom:1"}}}
		}`),
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse stored runtime profile: %v", err)
	}
	if code != "CUSTOM_WORKSPACE" || !strings.Contains(string(compose), "custom:1") {
		t.Fatalf("expected exact stored runtime profile, got %q %s", code, compose)
	}
}
